分档位解读
0.2‑0.4 mp
低分辨率，画面模糊，细节少；适合快速预览测试。
✅0.5‑0.7 mp【黄金稳定区间】（最推荐日常出片）
16:9 →960×544 ~1152×640
细节足够，闪烁少、肢体崩坏概率低，人物不容易变形。
0.8‑1.0 mp 高像素档位
分辨率更高，细节会多一点，但副作用明显：更容易画面闪烁、肢体崩坏、人脸漂移；
1.2 ~2.0 mp（1920×1088）高危档位
像素最高：H3 模型原生训练并没有大量 1080P 样本；
开 2.0 经常出现：疯狂闪烁、肢体错乱、物体抖动，很多时候反而画质观感不如 0.6‑0.7；

subject_definitions:

<Video 1> is the original reference video. It provides the exact motion, performance, timing, body movements, camera movement, camera framing, perspective, environment, lighting, and temporal structure.

<Picture 1> is the reference image of the new woman. It provides the identity and visual appearance of the replacement subject, including her face, hairstyle, hair color, skin tone, facial features, body appearance, clothing, accessories, and overall identity.

summary:

[reference generation] Replace the woman in <Video 1> with the woman from <Picture 1>. Completely remove the original woman from the video and replace her with <Subject 1> from <Picture 1>, while preserving the exact same motion, body movements, timing, gestures, camera movement, framing, environment, and overall sequence of <Video 1>.

retention_analysis:

<Video 1>: attribute_transfer - use the original video as the source for motion, choreography, body movement, timing, camera movement, camera framing, perspective, lighting, environment, and temporal structure.

<Picture 1>: fully_preserved - use the woman from <Picture 1> as the replacement subject. Preserve her facial identity, facial features, hairstyle, hair color, skin tone, clothing, accessories, and overall appearance.

Original woman in <Video 1>: fully_replaced - do not preserve the original woman's identity or appearance. Replace her completely with the woman from <Picture 1>.

Motion: fully_preserved - transfer the exact original motion from <Video 1> to the woman from <Picture 1>. Her movements must follow the same timing, trajectory, poses, gestures, speed, and body dynamics as the original woman.

detailed_description:

Create a photorealistic video using <Video 1> as the exact motion and scene reference and <Picture 1> as the identity and appearance reference.

Completely remove the original woman from <Video 1> and replace her with the woman shown in <Picture 1>.

The woman from <Picture 1> becomes the only main subject in the generated video. Preserve her exact facial identity, facial structure, hairstyle, hair color, skin tone, clothing, accessories, and overall appearance.

MOST IMPORTANT: transfer the EXACT motion of the original woman from <Video 1> onto the woman from <Picture 1>.

She must perform precisely the same movements at precisely the same moments as the original woman in <Video 1>. Preserve the exact sequence of actions, body movements, poses, gestures, arm movements, hand movements, head movements, facial expressions where appropriate, walking or dancing movements, speed, timing, acceleration, deceleration, and transitions.

Do not create new movements. Do not improvise. Do not simplify the choreography. Do not alter the original performance.

The new woman should occupy the same position and follow the same movement trajectories as the original woman throughout the video.

Preserve the exact camera movement from <Video 1>, 

Preserve the exact environment from <Video 1>, including the background,  lighting, shadows, reflections, and atmospheric conditions. The scene should remain visually identical except for the replacement of the woman.

Maintain the original interaction between the woman and the environment. If the original woman moves her hands, holds an object, walks, turns, looks around, or interacts with anything in <Video 1>, the woman from <Picture 1> should perform the same interaction at the same location and timing.

The replacement must be temporally consistent throughout the entire video. Her face, hair, clothing, body proportions, and identity must remain stable without morphing, flickering, identity drift, or appearance changes.

Maintain realistic human anatomy and physically believable motion. Her clothing and hair should naturally respond to the transferred movement.

The final video should look as if the woman from <Picture 1> was actually present in the original <Video 1> and performed the exact same actions herself.

Photorealistic live-action, seamless subject replacement, accurate motion transfer, exact temporal alignment, realistic lighting, natural human movement, stable identity, cinematic quality.

overall_soundscape:

Preserve the original soundscape and environmental audio from <Video 1> exactly, including background ambience, street sounds, footsteps, movement sounds, and other diegetic audio.

non_diegetic_music:

Preserve any existing music from <Video 1> exactly.




*************人物替换************

<Video 1> is the original reference video. It provides the exact body, body proportions, pose, motion, performance, timing, camera movement, camera framing, perspective, environment, lighting, and temporal structure.

<Picture 1> is the reference image of the new woman. It provides the replacement subject's head identity and clothing appearance: face, facial features, hairstyle, hair color, skin tone, garment type, garment color, garment design, fit, texture, and visible clothing details. Body shape, body proportions, pose, and motion from <Picture 1> are NOT used.

<Audio 1> is the original audio extracted from <Video 1>. It provides the original dialogue, speech timing, vocal performance, and ambient/diegetic audio reference.

summary:

[reference generation] Replace the original woman's head and clothing appearance in <Video 1> with the corresponding head identity and clothing appearance from <Picture 1>. Keep the original woman's body, body proportions, pose, motion, performance, camera work, and environment from <Video 1> completely unchanged. This is a head-and-clothing replacement, not a full character or body replacement.

Generate a photorealistic video using <Video 1> as the base for the original woman's body, body proportions, pose, motion, timing, camera, and scene, while using <Picture 1> as the reference for the replacement woman's head identity and clothing appearance.

Replace only the woman's head and clothing appearance. The replacement head must match the woman from <Picture 1> in face, facial features, hairstyle, hair color, and skin tone. The replacement clothing must match <Picture 1> in garment type, color, design, fit, material, texture, neckline, sleeves, patterns, and all other visible clothing details.

Keep the original woman's body, body proportions, pose, gestures, movement, and physical performance from <Video 1> completely unchanged. Do not use the body shape, proportions, pose, or movement from <Picture 1>. The new clothing must naturally conform to the original body and follow the exact body motion from <Video 1> while maintaining the appearance of the clothing from <Picture 1>.

Keep camera position, angle, movement, zoom, framing, perspective, and temporal structure identical to <Video 1>. Keep the environment — background, objects, lighting, shadows, reflections, and atmosphere — visually identical.

<Audio 1> is the original audio extracted from <Video 1>. Preserve and reproduce the speech performance from <Audio 1> exactly. The replacement woman's mouth and jaw must articulate the spoken dialogue in synchronization with <Audio 1>, following the same timing and phonetic articulation as the original speaker. Do not suppress, freeze, or neutralize the mouth movement.

The replacement head must follow the exact head movement, angle, tilt, eye direction, facial expressions, and timing of the original woman in <Video 1>. During speech, reproduce the original mouth opening, closing, lip shapes, jaw movement, and facial articulation in synchronization with <Audio 1>.

The new clothing must remain visually consistent throughout the entire video. Preserve its exact color, material, texture, design, fit, and visible details from <Picture 1>. Do not revert to the original clothing from <Video 1>. Do not mix clothing elements from <Video 1> and <Picture 1>.

Preserve the original ambient and diegetic audio from <Video 1> exactly — background noise, footsteps, movement sounds, room tone, environmental sounds, and other sounds naturally present in the original video.

Maintain temporal consistency: the replacement face, hair, skin tone, and clothing must remain stable throughout, with no morphing, flickering, identity drift, texture changes, clothing changes, or temporal inconsistencies from frame to frame.

The final result should look as if the woman from <Picture 1> naturally has the original woman's body and is performing the exact same movement and performance from <Video 1>, while wearing the exact clothing shown in <Picture 1>. Photorealistic live-action, seamless head and clothing replacement, exact motion transfer, synchronized speech articulation, cinematic quality.
